records.title: Altitude Decompression Illness - The Operational Risk at Sustained Altitudes up to 35,000 ft
records.locator: Figures 4–6, printed pp. 37-6–37-7 (PDF pp. 7–8); methods pp. 37-2–37-4
records.figure_extraction_method: Visual reading of rendered bars checked against pixel height, repeated panels and existing final totals.
records.note: Each profile has 15 person-exposures. The paper does not provide linkage or per-timepoint attrition. Three endpoints are first detection of any VGE, first detection of grade IV VGE, and first reported symptoms consistent with DCI. The authors used a 240-minute assignment for undetected outcomes in a separate analysis. These rows use the actual cumulative bars and omit the previously catalogued 240-minute totals.
